title: My Family & My Body
source: NIES Grade 3 Block 2 revision booklet: family members & body parts word banks

scenes.t: Yahia has a big, happy family. His grandfather and grandmother live in Zagazig.
On Fridays, the whole family meets. Uncle Samy and Aunt Mona come with their children.
Yahia plays with his cousins. A cousin is the child of your uncle or aunt.
Look at your body in the mirror! You have a head, hair, two eyes, two ears, a nose, and a mouth.
Brush your teeth every morning and night to keep them white and strong.
We clap with our hands and fingers. We walk and run with our legs and feet.
Our shoulders, knees, elbows, and toes help us move and play every day.

items.a: The brother of your father or mother.
The sister of your father or mother.
The child of your uncle or aunt.
The father of your father or mother.
The mother of your father or mother.
The part in the middle of your arm that bends.
The part in the middle of your leg that bends.
The part that joins your hand to your arm.
